A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the inappropriate use of antibiotics in the treatment of urinary tract infections may cause the rapid rise of MDR bacteria with a high level of pathogenicity.
the inappropriate use of antibiotics is a serious threat for human health.
the inappropriate use of antibiotics in the therapy and prophylaxis of bacterial infections is one of the reasons of the rapid rise of multidrug resistant bacteria.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the inappropriate application of antimicrobials may cause a rapid emergence of Multidrug Resistance (MDR) and give bacteria the opportunity to modulate their virulence and bio-film formation.
the use of antibiotics should be restricted only for those patients who are in a real need of them.
the application of antibiotics should be carefully planned in order to minimize the emergence of new MDR strains and the development of antibiotic resistance.
